summary: Scott County, AR tower listed only as removed in 1974; a lookout guide and a federal survey describe a Buck Knob in the same county, identity unresolved.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The directory places Bear Knob in Scott County. The lookout guide and a 1956 federal survey name a Buck Knob tower in Scott County, and one guide passage appears to group a Buck Knob with Polk County towers. Not resolved: the sources do not show whether these are one tower under two names. The record is kept as Bear Knob.

sources.title: Lookouts of the Mena & Oden Ranger Districts, Arkansas

notes_for_editor: Only one page names Bear Knob, and it gives a removal year and county only. Checked 2026-10-10: a full-text search of the Mena and Oden guide finds no Bear Knob entry ('Bear' appears only in 'Smokey Bear'). Before publishing, check whether Bear Knob and Buck Knob (Scott County) are one site; the Buck Knob NGS description may describe the same tower. Record coordinates (34.9767, -93.7733) were not checked against any source. No corrections proposed. No visit or access data found. The story is short because the evidence is thin.
